newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Datatec buys U.K's Logical Networks.
newsitem.headline: Datatec buys U.K's Logical Networks.

text.p: South Africa's Datatec said on Thursday it is to buy U.K-based networks firm Logical Networks (LN) for 12 million stg, plus a further maximum of 20.0 million stg if the group achieves certain profit milestones.

The purchase, which takes effect from May 1, 1997, has been made from LN's shareholders -- including management and professional investors. The buy will facilitate Datatec's growth in the United Kingdom where it first set up shop in January.
Datatec said the initial payment would be settled through 8.0 million stg in cash and the 4.0 million balance through the issue of some 1.42 million combined units to the vendors at 21.00 rand each.

The 8.0 million would be settled through the issue of 2.51 million combined units which have been placed on behalf of the vendors with international institutions at an average price of 23.54 ranc a unit.
The remaining 20.0 million will be paid either through cash or shares.

LN achieved profit after tax of 440,000 stg in the year to end November 1996 on turnover of 27.02 million stg, Datatec said. The accounts of LN for the seven-month period to June 30, 1997 indicates that pre-tax profit exceeds that achieved for the full 1996 year.
